title: An LRU cache with the recency right
why: The recency update on read and on overwrite is the whole task, and a `Map` without re-insertion gets both wrong in a way that only shows up on the third operation.
requirements: Write `src.js` exporting `createLru(capacity)` returning an object with `get(key)`, `put(key, value)` and a `size` getter. `get` on a missing key returns `undefined` and does not change the cache. `get` on a present key makes it the most recently used. `put` on an existing key updates both value and recency. When the cache would exceed `capacity`, evict the least recently used entry. With `capacity` of 0, nothing is stored and `size` stays 0. No dependencies.
